source.description: Reviewed handmade raster felt-tip-marker process contact sheet.
source.notes: One cheerful face-forward cartoon octopus with exactly eight countable arms; no lettering, labels, arrows, numbers, UI, signatures, watermarks, sticker edge, badge frame, ocean scene, or extra animal.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels move from one mantle guide and eight fixed arm routes to a stable eight-arm silhouette, face, suckers, bubbles, complete ink and color decisions, marker texture, and a finishing-only pass.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one round mantle guide, one face axis, eight numbered-in-plan but unlabeled arm routes, two eye ticks, one mouth tick, three bubble circles, and one broken shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: One round mantle guide with a vertical face axis and two eye ticks
anchor_map.becomes: The octopus mantle, lower body, and cheerful face
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The mantle stays centered above the arm fan; both eyes remain level and the mouth stays centered below them.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale circle, axis, and ticks only in Panel 1; the soft mantle silhouette begins in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: Eight distinct arm routes fanning from the lower body
anchor_map.becomes: Exactly eight thick tapering arms with eight visible tips
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: From left to right the routes remain: up-left curl, left horizontal, lower-left, front-left, front-right, lower-right, right horizontal, and up-right curl; no route swaps sides, crosses another tip, disappears, or splits.
anchor_map.construction_note: Single pale center routes only until all eight arm contours are wrapped in Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: Three bubble circles and one broken shadow route
anchor_map.becomes: Exactly three aqua bubbles above the right arm fan and one navy broken shadow beneath the front arms
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The bubbles remain in a rising diagonal at upper right and the shadow stays behind the two front arms.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale circles and route only until Panel 4 and Panel 5.

final_elements.name: mantle face eight-arm bubble and shadow construction guides
final_elements.description: One mantle circle, one face axis, eight fixed arm routes, two eye ticks, one mouth tick, three bubble circles, and one broken shadow route.

final_elements.name: rounded mantle and lower body silhouette
final_elements.description: One soft rounded mantle connected to one shallow lower body above the arm fan.

final_elements.name: exactly eight tapering arms with fixed tips
final_elements.description: Eight countable arms in the planned left-to-right order, each with one distinct visible tip and no crossing routes.

final_elements.name: cheerful face sixteen suckers and three bubbles
final_elements.description: Two oval eyes, one smiling mouth, exactly sixteen visible sucker circles with two on each arm, and exactly three bubbles.

final_elements.name: six mantle spots two highlights and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Exactly six small mantle spots, two open-paper head highlights, simple cheek marks, and one broken ground shadow.

final_elements.name: black marker and complete coral purple aqua yellow and navy color map
final_elements.description: Thick imperfect black outlines with coral mantle and arms, purple underside accents, aqua bubbles, yellow spots, and navy shadow.

final_elements.name: directional marker texture and small contour accents
final_elements.description: Visible marker streaks, clarified sucker rings, small cheek accents, and established highlight and shadow refinement.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The broken shadow and lower-body keeper lines stop at the reserved arm silhouettes, and no finished body contour crosses an arm base.

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, a drifting mantle or face, or any arm route that swaps position, disappears, splits, crosses, or changes tip direction after appearing.
Reject missing or extra arms, arm tips, suckers, bubbles, spots, eyes, highlights, or a shadow that covers a front arm.
Reject a final that introduces anatomy, color regions, seaweed, fish, shells, lettering, a logo, sticker edge, badge frame, or other prop absent earlier.
Reject vector-like fills, glossy poster rendering, repeated faint-to-dark tracings, labels, arrows, numbers, text, signatures, or watermarks.
